title: Paraclr technical demo: the working product on Monad testnet

lines.text: October twenty twenty-five. Crypto's largest liquidation day ever.
More than nineteen billion dollars. One point six million traders. In twenty-four hours.
Every one of those liquidations was a race. Bots bid gas to land first.
The winner takes a penalty that was fixed in advance. And the trader pays it,
Paraclr replaces the race with a clock.
This is Paraclr, live on Monad testnet with test funds. I sign in with Privy, by email. No seed phrase.
The app drips gas for fees, and Agora's faucet sends test AUSD.
I deposit ten AUSD and open a three times leveraged long on SOL. The order is committed now and filled at the next Pyth price. This one filled in three seconds.
Here is the position. I close it. The close also fills at the next Pyth price, with a small realized gain.
Envio indexes every order. And every fill is a real transaction. Here is the close on the Monad testnet explorer.

This is the Clearing tab. Each row is a lane, and every account lives in one of eight. Mine is in lane six. If an account falls below maintenance, a Dutch auction starts in its lane, and the discount rises five basis points every block. On this deployment, no account has needed one yet.
The Backstop tab shows one pool per lane. A pool can take an account from a seventy-five basis point discount, and it inherits the positions. Nothing has been taken here yet, so earnings show zero.
Now crash the market. Anyone can, in the Arena. One click drops prices twenty percent.
Each lane runs its own auctions, and the backstops take them, lane by lane, in seconds.
The Arena then traces the crash's transactions. Paraclr's lanes have zero cross-lane dependencies. The shared-state build has eleven.
Our measured runs on Monad testnet agree: zero against forty-nine, and auctions that took twenty-eight percent less from traders than a fixed fee.
Built on Monad, with Agora AUSD, Pyth, Privy and Envio. Not yet audited.
Paraclr. Fair liquidations for Monad. Crash it yourself, at paraclr dot x y z.
